yuko_tanaka: Quick report from today's onboarding of sparrow-lite-q4f on staging. We saw token boundary attachment when a zero-width char (ZWSP U+200B / ZWJ U+200D) sits between katakana and kanji. Embedding cosine to fp16 baseline drops for affected short queries. Anyone familiar with fastpath tokenizer differences?

samir_khan: Can you paste a tiny repro + which tokenizer vendored?

yuko_tanaka: vendor rn-tokenizer v2.7.0. Repro commands I ran (escaped for clarity):

```
# fp16 baseline
rn_tokenizer inspect --model sparrow-lite --mode fp16 --text "\u30ab\u30ca\u200b\u6f22"
# q4f fastpath
rn_tokenizer inspect --model sparrow-lite --mode q4f --text "\u30ab\u30ca\u200b\u6f22"
```

fp16 -> tokens ["\u30ab\u30ca", "\u6f22"] ids [2910, 9872]
q4f  -> tokens ["\u30ab\u30ca\u200b", "\u6f22"] ids [2910, 41299]  <-- ZWSP attached and id remapped high

clare_zhu: That pattern matches when normalization is reduced in the fast tokenizer path and the grapheme cluster algorithm "glues" the invisible joiner to the previous cluster. Did the q4f image set TOKEN_NORM=fast or skip NFKC?

yuko_tanaka: Checked build metadata: TOKEN_NORM=fast for q4f (fp16 uses full). Also noticed packer assigns extension ids for surfaces produced only at runtime -> hence ids >= 40k.

samir_khan: How big is the user-visible impact?

yuko_tanaka: Ran a focused retrieval set (n=160 JP short queries). ~19% affected when ZWSP/ZWJ present. For affected samples: embedding cosine median fell from 0.96 -> 0.77, recall@5 dropped ~6 points. NMT BLEU barely changes (~0.15) because detok normalizes downstream. So retrieval/NN tasks are sensitive.

runtime-bot: started job sparrow-lite-q4f-zwx-smoke-3009990000 (staging)

clare_zhu: Short-term mitigation: canonicalize inputs at the gateway to NFKC and optionally strip ZWSP/ZWJ before tokenization. That aligns q4f fastpath behavior with fp16 without touching runtime. Perf impact: we measured ~0.35ms median per request for the extra normalize+strip on our testbench.

samir_khan: Long-term options: enable full normalization in q4f builds, or add an opt-in config that enables strict grapheme segmentation for Dedicated/Private deployments. Either way add a qX build matrix test to exercise both fast and full modes.

infra-bot: note: packer assertions enabled: token_id <= vocab_size + 2048 check recommended

clare_zhu: Also add a unit in tokenizer CI covering invisible chars (ZWSP, ZWJ, thin-space, NBSP) and a small nightly eval comparing embeddings between qX and fp16 for multilingual edgecases.

yuko_tanaka: I pushed a short-term gateway preproc (strip_zw=true) to staging and re-ran the smoke suite. Affected cosine median recovered to ~0.91 and recall@5 recovered ~5 pts. Filed ticket INF-7321 "ZWSP/ZWJ grapheme attachment in q4f fast tokenizer" and attached repro + smoke logs. Assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml.

samir_khan: Two follow-ups: 1) can eng-runtime add an opt-in normalize flag to the fast tokenizer so Dedicated customers can turn it on? 2) infra, please add a guard in packer to fail if runtime produces token surfaces not present in the pre-export map unless explicitly allowed.

clare_zhu: Will add tokenizer tests and a tiny CI job to compare token sequences vs fp16 baseline for a small corpus including CJK and RTL samples. Also will add a regression alert for retrieval metrics on JP that triggers if recall@5 drops >3 pts in nightly.

yuko_tanaka: TL;DR: root cause = q4f fastpath normalization reduced -> invisible chars attach to preceding grapheme -> different token ids (extension slot) -> embedding/retrieval regressions. Mitigation = gateway strip + ticket to decide runtime defaults. Rolling preproc to Dedicated canary tonight.

samir_khan: Nice catch. Please paste INF-7321 link once it's created and let's coordinate the runtime patch and the packer guard in the same release window.

yuko_tanaka: Will do, thanks everyone :pray:
